title: Tamsin and the Hollow
author: Ansel Lockridge
blurb: Wendell Blackwood, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
